content:
**OPNduck v0.5.2-Beta** 🦆

**New**
• Home is now a compact grid of tool tiles - one tool open at a time
• New themed startup screen with a bobbing duck
• Pixel look: pixel wordmark and pixel scatter behind pages
• Calmer Blarange colours, sharper corners, plainer wording
• Readable text and icons in every Omarchy palette
• Faster engine-check cards, more developer tools

Beta: expect bugs. Windows installers untested on real Windows. Tauri still postponed (WebKitGTK stutters/crashes with NVIDIA + Wayland).
